row.team_price_text: No new subscriptions (sold as HubSpot Breeze Intelligence)
row.sso_plan: Standard Bundle, Enrichment or Clearbit Platform
row.evidence: Clearbit's help centre says its SAML integration 'provides just-in-time (JIT) provisioning by default' and that admins remove users manually under Manage Team > Users; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: Clearbit has joined HubSpot and no longer sells new standalone subscriptions (clearbit.com/pricing redirects to the home page); HubSpot points new buyers to Breeze Intelligence, which is administered inside HubSpot (see the hubspot row). For existing Standard Bundle, Enrichment and Clearbit Platform customers, Clearbit offers SAML 2.0 SSO set up with a Clearbit Implementation Manager via a custom SAML app (Okta, Entra, Google, JumpCloud or any IdP) with JIT user creation; offboarding is manual in Manage Team > Users. The help centre has no SCIM article. Okta's OIN Clearbit app is SWA only. Clearbit API docs now redirect to a login page and no user-management API is documented publicly.

plans.name: Standard Bundle / Enrichment / Clearbit Platform (existing customers)
plans.price_text: Not publicly priced; no new standalone subscriptions

scim.notes: No SCIM article in the help centre (sitemap and search for SCIM return nothing); provisioning is SAML JIT and removal is manual.

user_api.notes: Clearbit's data APIs (enrichment, reveal) are documented behind a login (clearbit.com/docs redirects to app.clearbit.com/auth/login); no team or user management API is documented publicly.

okta.notes: OIN app is SWA only; Clearbit's own guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app because it 'isn't available in Okta's integration library'.

entra.notes: Custom non-gallery SAML app per Clearbit's guide.

google.notes: Clearbit publishes a Google SSO SAML setup guide; provisioning is JIT.

jumpcloud.notes: Clearbit publishes a JumpCloud SAML setup guide; provisioning is JIT.

fallbacks.other_sync: Accounts created since 2024 add users by OAuth sign-in with HubSpot credentials (mapped to the HubSpot team)
